node.statement: For each integer m with 1<=m<=q, define D_m:S_{P_j,Q_[1,m]}->direct-sum_{k=1}^m S_{P_j,Q_k} recursively. Let D_1 be the identity (using Q_[1,1]=Q_1). For m>=2, let B_m:S_{P_j,Q_[1,m]}->S_{P_j,Q_[1,m-1]} direct-sum S_{P_j,Q_m} be the bounded linear bijection supplied by node 1.4.1, and put D_m=(D_{m-1} direct-sum id) composed with B_m. Induction gives a bounded linear bijection D_m: the direct sum of two bounded linear maps is bounded for the max norm, composition preserves boundedness, and an explicit bounded inverse is B_m^{-1} composed with (D_{m-1}^{-1} direct-sum id).
